performance.caveat: Studio phone emulation; not physical handset throughput. Pixel material has greater CPU cost than original smooth GUI; 32% improvement compares 64 vs 84 span prototypes.

fixesFoundByNativeQA: Successful image allocation did not prove write access: protected initial background write now chooses pooled spans on denial.
Opaque LCD covered threshold and pressure caption: restored Z order, contrasting native-sized text.
Initial owner fixture compared a deformed spawn center to raw origin: one natural spring-settle wait; unchanged strict resume tolerance.
Redundant per-row clipping caused phone-emulator seams despite contiguous geometry: removed row clip, kept outer and tray clip.
limitations: No physical phone, live multiplayer or live-account save/rejoin evidence.
EditableImage enabled path cannot be exercised under the existing experience setting; automatic denial, bounded span, overflow and failure paths were exercised.
Known EditableImage-disabled and asset203785492 type warnings remain. Final ordinary-play console had no new runtime exception.
review: Astra plan, source, fixture and final rendered GO; Sol implementation. Root native QA and release coordination.
